span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Differential distribution of HCN channel subtypes across neuron classes (or, alternatively, second-messenger modulation of Ih) produces the observed differences in Ih kinetics and voltage dependence
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: GABAergic neurons carry a slow Ih because their current is conducted by channels assembled from HCN2 and HCN4 subunits
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Fast Ih in excitatory neurons is carried by HCN1/HCN2 channels while slow Ih is carried by HCN2 and sometimes HCN4, so subunit composition sets the kinetic class
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Because HCN4 is restricted to GABAergic cells and is cAMP-sensitive, neuromodulators that raise second-messenger levels would selectively retune the integrative properties of the inhibitory population
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A large, fast-activating Ih depolarizes the membrane after release from hyperpolarization and thereby enables rebound spiking in specific excitatory subclasses
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Slice preparation and recording configuration may have biased sampling toward particular GABAergic cell types, so further subclasses may exist.
span.note: what this limits: the completeness of the subclass list: BRAIN SLICE PREPARATION AND RECORDING CONFIGURATIONS MAY HAVE BIASED OUR SAMPLE TOWARD ONE NEURON TYPE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Low-prevalence GABAergic types could have been missed given the sample size.
span.note: what this limits: any claim that a type is absent: OTHER GABAERGIC NEURON TYPES WITH LOW PREVALENCE (10% OR LOWER) MAY HAVE ESCAPED OUR SAMPLE DUE TO OUR RELATIVELY LOW SAMPLE SIZE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The current-clamp sag measures used to group cells are only partial proxies for Ih amplitude and kinetics.
span.note: what this limits: the grouping variable itself: THESE TWO PARAMETERS ONLY PARTIALLY CORRELATE WITH Ih AMPLITUDE AND Ih ACTIVATION TIME CONSTANT BUT ALSO DEPEND ON MEMBRANE CAPACITANCE AND THE ACTIVATION OF OTHER VOLTAGE-GATED ION CHANNELS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The physiological classification alone may not exhaust the GABAergic populations; molecular profiling could split them further.
span.note: what this limits: the physiological classification as a final answer: FURTHER PHYSIOLOGICAL MEASUREMENTS OR MOLECULAR PROFILING MAY REVEAL DIFFERENT POPULATIONS OF GABAERGIC IC NEURONS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The dividing line between the two groups is a chosen value, and the neurons that do not fit it are named in the same sentence.
span.note: what this limits: the two Ih groups as natural kinds: the boundary is an activation time constant chosen by the authors at 235 ms, with two intermediate neurons stated not to follow it
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The inhibitory population is reported as undivided BY THESE MEASUREMENTS, with the authors stating the preparation may have biased the sample toward one type.
span.note: what this limits: the finding that GABAergic IC neurons form a single physiological class: the authors state this holds for these measurements and that the preparation may have biased the sample toward one type
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A detection floor is stated: cell types at or below 10% prevalence may simply not be in the sample.
span.note: what this limits: the absence of a GABAergic subtype in these data as evidence it does not exist: the authors state types at 10% prevalence or lower may have escaped the sample given its size
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A measurement is declared biased with its direction named, and then argued not to affect the comparison that rests on it.
span.note: what this limits: the reported time constants for slow-Ih neurons: the authors state Ih was not fully activated at the measurement point, so the taus are underestimates, and argue the group differences survive
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the dorso-ventral extent of each inferior colliculus normalised from zero to one before being divided into five regions
span.note: eliminates: differences in absolute size between animals - without normalising, the same anatomical position falls in different regions in different brains
